description: Navy service school codes relevant to Medical Corps officers, as they appear in the OSR 'Service Schools Attended' block (Block 52). Only codes with a named source are listed; the authoritative full list is the NOOCS Manual Volume II, Appendix C.
howToAdd: Email askmncc@navy.mil with the course completion certificate.

102.name: Advanced Readiness Officer Course (AROC)
102.note: The CDB brief lists code 102 as the Advanced Medical Department Officer Course (AMDOC); the FY27 catalog lists the same code for AROC, which superseded it.

077.name: Commander Amphibious Task Force Surgeon Course (CATF-S)

059.name: Interagency Institute for Federal Health Leaders (IAIFHL)

422.name: Naval War College Fleet Seminar Program (JPME I)

414.name: Naval War College JPME I & Master's Resident Program

700.name: Air Command and Staff College Distance Learning (JPME I)
